reward_terms.name: hand_clearance
reward_terms.formula: Increase in distance from the nearest pad after supported release. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress
reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

body.reflection: At the shorter-horizon curriculum cap the learned actor reaches 58 exact of 64 with 64 lifts and turns, all checks clear and max excursion 10.35 mrad. This matches the incumbent on the main set. Earlier scheduled exports remain to be scored.

body.text: At matched 60 Hz handover samples before opening, median vertical table load is 21.35–26.76 plug weights over five failed transfers and 23.88–29.17 over four completed transfers. Both groups press substantially while grasping. A smaller load is a testable intervention, with no causal conclusion from these measurements. Add a small quadratic cost above 10 weights capped at 40, only during continuous supported handover while the hand still touches. Preserve the positive support rewards. On 38 dry starts mean returns are +43.622 physical, -0.790 hold and -0.971 random. Physical plans pay zero mean added cost, with 11 fault-free terminals. Allocate 10M from r0445 at 0.00006, with the same substep finger-risk term and 2M exports.

The first 4M PPO window with an averaged export reaches 63/64 exact and no hardware or state-log faults. The final average of that 12M trial reaches 54/64. An independent audit of the stronger export is running. Open a matched 10M average-export trial starting with the lower excursion r0445 actor, keeping its substep risk reward and a decay of 0.95 per PPO optimization iteration. This tests whether weight averaging preserves ordered skill and safety while adapting from a different learned point. Keep standard PPO collection and optimization and export a single network.

body.reflection: After the early unstable export, the short-horizon comparison reaches 55 of 64 exact with 64 turns and no stops, measured hardware violations or state errors. Continue to cap.

body.text: The exact ordered handover can fail on a single 60 Hz support break or tilt. The Warp-versus-CPU station check agreed on aggregate fixed-plan completion, but that check cannot establish agreement for every handover state. Continue directly on the same CPU Station implementation as frozen v4 from r0445 using clipped PPO, the existing demonstration waypoint and contact reward, measured substep risk, and no teachers, trajectories or privileged critic. Dry reward check on 12 starts with 8 s horizon: r0445 mean actor +79.963 and 12 reward terminal goals without stops or physical violations, hold -0.490, random -0.860. Reserve up to 600k new on-policy steps or 95 minutes with exports each 100k. Sample 70 percent nominal and 30 percent moderate reset dynamics perturbations, cap action standard deviation at 0.35, and average this single actor's parameters at decay 0.90 per update. Fresh optimizer moments and a 0.00003 learning rate suit the lower throughput. Nine 8 s batches and one 60 s batch per cycle. Predict higher independent exact transfer than the Warp-based substep actor, while checking for new state errors and stops.

body.text: Seven of eight reproduced carry failures were camera-invalid around loss of support or excessive tilt. The existing stack skips the immediately preceding fingers and targets, which are available under contract v3. Test dense raw hand history at one and three policy steps back. No velocity, contact, clock or extra sensor is supplied. Extend the same 224-wide PPO actor and critic with 80 zero-initialized input weights per hidden unit and pad the Adam moments likewise. NumPy and Torch agree within 6.86e-7 on 480 replayed observations with asynchronous resets and bootstrap preview. The smoke export validates under v3 with 0.939 ms p99. From r0445 run 10M active steps at 0.00006 and 2M export spacing. Predict more continuous handovers while preserving the substep finger safety gain.

body.text: Before the 1 ms audit excursions, the middle PIP could remain over one radian from a filtered target while held by another finger or the plug. The independent violation accelerated through -30.73 rad/s after separation with filtered target inside the limit. Hardware documents blocked-finger errors of 4.5 to 13 degrees. Test a small reward cost on filtered PIP gaps above 0.45 rad when the same target lies near the joint limit. This changes the reward on simulator state only. Dry 38-start plan return +41.426 with nine fault-free terminals and no added cost, hold -0.790 and random -0.971. Give this single reward change 8M active PPO steps from r0445 at 0.00006 on the same v4 GPU simulation, exporting every 2M. Predict smaller substep excursions without reducing exact full starts.

body.reflection: The second direct CPU PPO export completes 55 of 64 exact. It lifts in all episodes, turns in 62, and keeps every measured hardware, stop and contract check clear. Peak measured excursion is 9.46 mrad. The first CPU export completes 58 and the parent 62 on the same starts.

body.text: The v4 audit reproduced a joint excursion of 22.08 mrad with middle PIP peak 32.32 rad/s after self-contact released, versus the public table value 12.863 rad/s. The near miss had 15.17 mrad and 26.04 rad/s. Evaluate a separate physical actuator model that retains full current-limited torque through 90 percent of the published unloaded speed, then tapers driving torque linearly to zero at that speed. Braking torque remains available and contact can drive a joint faster. This breakpoint keeps the previously calibrated response below 90 percent of speed, and is an assumption because the current- and voltage-limit curve is not measured. On 24 ordinary matched 8 s diagnostic starts, both this and a 70 percent sensitivity variant preserve 23 continuous handovers with zero hardware violations and stops. The 90 percent model gives 4.98 and 2.40 mrad on the two selected stress replays. Before considering suite registration, check no-load filter/delay, ordinary contact sequences and CPU/Warp outcome parity against fixed criteria. v4 and its failed final remain on record.

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: upright_descent_margin
reward_terms.formula: During carry or support transfer, inside the goal zone and within 65 mm of the table-standing height with hand contact, cost scales in cosine space from no cost at 10 degrees to the full cost at 35 degrees.

reward_terms.name: substep_finger_limit_risk
reward_terms.formula: Take the maximum over all 20 joints and all 1 ms substeps of the 30 Hz interval. The per-joint risk is the larger of the 5–20 mrad overshoot ramp and the product of proximity within 35 mrad and toward-limit speed scaled from 5 to 17 rad/s. A first actual violation adds a terminal penalty of 4.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress
reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

simulator.name: MuJoCo
simulator.gpu_backend: MuJoCo Warp GPU solver with matched model and commands, using float32 dynamics.
simulator.finger_motor_limit: Directional torque cap with full current-limited effort through 90% of public joint speed and a linear taper to zero at the published speed.

scene.model: Full provided Marvin Wuji MJCF, both arms/hands and original collision geometry, with a single plug, table, floor, and column.

plug.state_frame: Housing centre, +Z toward blade tips, +Y across the blade gap. Identity object/body frame.
plug.geometry: Station housing and two blade OBJ parts from given/recon. Exact specified dimensions and axes.
plug.physical_prior: The comparable charger teardown weighs 58.5 g. The video supports the housing geometry and grasp scale, with no force data. Used the operator 60 g estimate and housing-plus-blades bounding-box inertia. Contact pair assumptions are 0.40 sliding at the table, 0.80 hand material friction. The PC-glass study is a material prior and its interface differs from the station. The video shows little post-release slide but does not identify either coefficient.
plug.contact: Housing and two blades have separate convex collision meshes. Elliptic sliding and torsional contact, solref 0.012 s / damping ratio 1, solimp [0.93,0.98,0.001].

reference.method: White cycle with d2s_reference progress, object start and goal alignment and SLERP. Palm axis mapping is derived from reconstructed MANO joints. Applying a world-up yaw adjustment of 150 degrees to the wrist and its offset selects a more reachable approach heading while keeping plug start and goal constraints. The palm height is projected above -0.225 m in the retarget. These embodiment adjustments guide rewards and are not executed trajectories.

body.arm: Published 100 Hz palm clamp and jump stop, measured-seed DLS IK with the 5 degree ranges, delayed 100 Hz joint reference and velocity, and the provided arm capsules. The position actuator receives q_ref + (D/K) q_ref_dot so velocity tracking effort is counted inside each motor's effort cap. Compensate modeled bias minus gravity compensation separately. Use only contact EFC rows for the right arm or hand against table, plug, column or parked arm to estimate external torque with J transpose f. The existing 30 ms estimated torque filter and 20 Nm halt operate on that signal.
body.hand: Public geometry and deployed limits including the 1 mm glove collision margin. Finger targets have 35 ms delay and 2 Hz low pass. Internal position gains are 12x vendor kp and 3x vendor kv as a response approximation with current-limited torque. Nominal evaluation uses 0.6x joint effort, with 0.1 deg encoder noise. The deployed finger ranges remain fixed. A 2 ms unilateral joint-limit time constant at 1 ms physics integration reduces numerical penetration through the range. The 100 Hz filter and existing proprioceptive delays are unchanged. The driving torque caps use each joint speed from RIGHT_HAND.md section 2 at every 1 ms substep. The opposite-direction cap retains the nominal braking torque. Contact can backdrive the joint past the published speed because the model does not clip joint velocity or angle.
body.sensor: Default d2s_sensor.PoseSensor fed at 60 Hz. 48 surface samples from the complete object mesh, visual points clipped by calibrated ego-camera geometry. Arm caps and fitted capsules for hand-link mesh occluders. Proprioception delayed by a lognormal draw quantized to the nearest 60 Hz row.

initial_conditions.object: Uniform independent x/y offsets ±10 mm and blade yaw ±10 degrees about -90 degrees, X-up on the supported face.
initial_conditions.start_check: Hold controller uses the reset palm so the entire hold check, including any ramp rows, can test a stationary hand. Candidate evaluation simulates the actual package start ramp.

validation.geometry_and_render_reuse: Compare identical mesh and transform hashes. The demonstration visualization is kinematic with zero joint velocities. The displayed scene and reference trajectories therefore apply to this model as well.
validation.free_finger_response_summary: Three PIP joints in separate 0.20, 0.55 and 1.10 rad open-hand steps, with no hand contacts or stops. Six smaller steps have identical positions. Three 1.10 rad steps deviate at most 3.59 mrad and reach 12.73 to 12.76 rad/s, versus 13.26 to 13.28 in v4. RMS measured-to-filtered-target error grows by at most 0.22 mrad.
validation.paired_torque_speed_sensitivity: The 8 s audit on 24 ordinary draws retains 23 continuous handovers for v4 and for both envelope breakpoints. The two selected load-release stress cases peak at 32.32 and 26.04 rad/s in v4. With the 90% envelope they peak at 13.02 and 12.99 rad/s and excursions are 4.98 and 2.40 mrad, against 22.08 and 15.17 mrad. This diagnostic uses the same actor and perturbations, separate from gate assessment.

cpu_gpu_outcome_parity.criterion: Outcome parity (same policy, both backends, >= min-seeds seeds, scored by the evaluator's judge) is the criterion that counts. State-level and replay checks are diagnostics.

body.limitations: The voltage-limited torque curve is assumed. Only the published speed, existing current-limit effort and prior unloaded response constrain it. The first breakpoint is a modeling assumption, and the two sensitivity breakpoints do not uniquely identify the real motor. Contact may still backdrive a joint beyond the listed speed. The kinematic replay has a 3.75 mm maximum nominal hand-object overlap. This simulation covers one deployed white plug. It does not establish real robot success.

revision.cause: The v4 final r0424 has one finger excursion of 22.81 mrad even though the manipulation stages pass. r0435 reproduces the same type of excursion after an inter-finger contact releases, with measured simulated PIP speed more than twice the public 12.863 rad/s. Current limiting alone leaves unrealistic motor power at that speed.
revision.implementation: Change only the joint-motor effort envelope as a function of the measured simulated speed. Keep the 1 ms integrator, 2 ms unilateral joint limits, commands, filters, stopping checks, sensor, meshes and deployment criteria. The same formula runs in a Warp kernel.

gpu_backend.physics: MuJoCo Warp with the same directional effort taper at each 1 ms step and the same nominal table, controller and mesh models.
gpu_backend.validation: 128 matched fixed-plan starts. CPU 22 exact and GPU 18 exact, no hardware violations, drops or stops. Outcome parity PASS. Individual contact paths and sensor random draws still differ.

gate_evidence.seen: r0424: Seed 1518508316 is near the fingertips at 2.30 s and upright after opening by 10 s. The same gate's measured 22.81 mrad excursion was in seed 704533316. In the independent 1 ms replay r0435, a finger accelerates after inter-finger contact releases and exceeds twice its published joint speed. r0571 records the paired speed-envelope diagnosis.

reward_terms.name: recontact

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal

reward_terms.name: excess_table_load

reward_terms.name: substep_finger_limit_risk

The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

body.reflection: This lighter-load export reaches 60 ordered handovers and 55 final placements on the frozen evaluation. It completes one exact contract-clean episode, with 61 state-log errors, five stops and three measured violations. The earlier 59-of-64 checkpoints kept state checks clear.

body.text: The r0402 actor in v5 completes 61/64 and 122/128 from its first two development cohorts with no measured hardware violations or stops. Seed 548968115 has a reachable palm-target tracking gap of 85 mm at 4.47 s, beyond the 80 mm contract check, and exceeds 65 degrees of wrist rotation in its opposed grip. A 16-start counterfactual using the same network and a 75 mm measured-palm translation lead cap eliminates that state error and completes all stages on the focal seed. One previously successful start loses its transfer, so both variants still complete 15/16. This is a diagnostic only. If the new feasibility gate passes, test a six-million-step PPO continuation with that bounded action map alongside a matched unchanged-map v5 continuation. Predict retention of exact transfer with fewer position-tracking errors across independent starts.

body.text: Gate r0591 proves v5 feasibility with 25/32 complete ordered episodes, 32/32 lifts and turns, no measured hardware violations or stops, and reproducible replays. In both failure montages the plug is initially pinched and stands upright and clear by 17.70 s, but the measured ordered carry-release stage fails. Both successful montages show continuous reported handover and over 50 s of hands-off rest. The v5 dry reward check gives +43.222 from physical plans, 11 fault-free terminals, -0.790 for hold and -0.969 for random. Start matched and 75 mm palm-lead Warp PPO continuations from r0402 on v5, each with 6M active steps at 0.00006 and 2M export spacing. Both include the same strict transfer, supported load and substep safety reward. Run a separate 600k direct CPU comparison from the same parent. Evaluate every scored export under the frozen v5 contract before choosing a baseline.

simulator.outcome_parity: 128 starts, 22 CPU successes and 16 GPU successes, zero hardware faults. The 1 ms fixed-plan 13 s outcome parity check passed.

reward_terms.name: approach_progress
reward_terms.formula: Potential decrease of wrist and opposing-pad pose error before grasp

reward_terms.name: opposition
reward_terms.formula: One-time qualifying thumb and opposing-contact grasp At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: lift_progress
reward_terms.formula: Increased unsupported centre rise while opposed, capped at 35 mm Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: Opposed lift above 15 mm for 0.10 s At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: reference_progress
reward_terms.formula: Sequential per-episode demonstration pose waypoints, opposed with active fingers Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: wrist_reference
reward_terms.formula: Palm position and orientation potential toward the selected reference

reward_terms.name: active_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Pay for episode-best combined blade elevation and relative rotation while unsupported, opposed and actively moving the fingers.

reward_terms.name: passive_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Variation of relative orientation under opposed contact with nearly stationary fingers

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: Completes at least 50 degrees of wrist-relative turn while opposed with blades within 20 degrees of up At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in left-goal distance weighted by blade elevation under opposed contact Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: place_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in upright standing-height and blade-axis errors inside goal with hand contact Also guide the centre toward the target XY. Carry advances to descent at least 15 mm inside the zone. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: support_transfer
reward_terms.formula: First table support with hand contact following the turn and carried goal entry At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: After controlled support transfer, stable upright table support with hand contact released At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: durable_goal
reward_terms.formula: Maintains terminal goal for 0.5 s, penalty for subsequent disturbance Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Loses the opposed airborne plug before support Also penalize and reset the grasp attempt if the transport returns to support before entry or loses opposition for two steps.

reward_terms.name: time_and_control
reward_terms.formula: Living cost, small action term, hand/table cost, and safety penalty

reward_terms.name: leftward_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed decrease in distance to goal y during opposed unsupported turn and carry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: settling_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in object speed during supported hand contact following carried entry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance
reward_terms.formula: Increase in distance from the nearest pad after supported release. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: substep_finger_limit_risk
reward_terms.formula: Take the maximum over all 20 joints and all 1 ms substeps of the 30 Hz interval. The per-joint risk is the larger of the 5–20 mrad overshoot ramp and the product of proximity within 35 mrad and toward-limit speed scaled from 5 to 17 rad/s. A first actual violation adds a terminal penalty of 4.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress
reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

curriculum.full_starts: Full start distribution and 1.5 s ramp. Evaluation covers 60 seconds.
curriculum.mid_state_actuators: Analytic static servo preload from grasp contact geometry; no source actions retained.
curriculum.switching: Reset mixture declines over the step budget. Reward-only waypoint stage progresses when object and hand states qualify.

evaluation.starts: Fixed independently drawn position and yaw perturbations within TASK_CONFIG.md, distinct sensor seeds.

local_evidence.method: Run and check every full episode. Keep the iteration video trace, selected clean completions, and up to two traces per failure class.

body.reflection: The first dense raw hand-history export reaches 60 of 64 exact with full lifts and 62 valid turns. No measured hardware violations, stops or state errors occur. Peak excursion is 18.22 mrad.

body.algorithm: PPO from scratch, clipped objective, GAE and independent deployable-observation critic

architecture.actor: 2 hidden SiLU layers with 26 Gaussian action means; mean inference
architecture.finger_action: Previous finger targets plus .093 rad bounded increments.
architecture.observation_anchor: Last valid camera estimate in the palm frame nearest image time, and subsequent proprioceptive finger displacement. Use preceding policy observation to approximate alignment. Carry this feature across camera loss, and clear it at reset.
architecture.continuation: When adding the 33 anchor inputs, extend both PPO first layers with zero weights, preserving the initial actor's behavior. Start the optimizer for the expanded shapes with no moments.

body.text: Matched 128-start CPU replays compare identical PPO packages across v4 and v5. For r0402 exact starts change 121 to 122, with four v5-only and three v4-only completions. Hardware violations change one to zero, peak finger excursion 22.08 to 5.53 mrad, and each model has one contract state error. For r0445 exact starts change 118 to 119, with two v5-only and one v4-only. The one v4 torque stop is absent in v5, while peak excursion changes 11.15 to 8.60 mrad. Both paired two-sided p values are 1.0. The hand motor correction addresses a measured response discrepancy and preserves similar completion rates on these starts.

reward_terms.name: reference_progress

reward_terms.name: wrist_reference
reward_terms.formula: Palm position and orientation potential toward the selected reference

reward_terms.name: active_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Pay for episode-best combined blade elevation and relative rotation while unsupported, opposed and actively moving the fingers.

reward_terms.name: passive_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Variation of relative orientation under opposed contact with nearly stationary fingers

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: Completes at least 50 degrees of wrist-relative turn while opposed with blades within 20 degrees of up At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in left-goal distance weighted by blade elevation under opposed contact Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: place_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in upright standing-height and blade-axis errors inside goal with hand contact Also guide the centre toward the target XY. Carry advances to descent at least 15 mm inside the zone. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: support_transfer
reward_terms.formula: First table support with hand contact following the turn and carried goal entry At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: After controlled support transfer, stable upright table support with hand contact released At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: durable_goal
reward_terms.formula: Maintains terminal goal for 0.5 s, penalty for subsequent disturbance Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Loses the opposed airborne plug before support Also penalize and reset the grasp attempt if the transport returns to support before entry or loses opposition for two steps.

reward_terms.name: time_and_control
reward_terms.formula: Living cost, small action term, hand/table cost, and safety penalty

reward_terms.name: leftward_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed decrease in distance to goal y during opposed unsupported turn and carry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: settling_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in object speed during supported hand contact following carried entry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance
reward_terms.formula: Increase in distance from the nearest pad after supported release. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: substep_finger_limit_risk
reward_terms.formula: Take the maximum over all 20 joints and all 1 ms substeps of the 30 Hz interval. The per-joint risk is the larger of the 5–20 mrad overshoot ramp and the product of proximity within 35 mrad and toward-limit speed scaled from 5 to 17 rad/s. A first actual violation adds a terminal penalty of 4.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress
reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: release

reward_terms.name: durable_goal

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance

reward_terms.name: recontact

reward_terms.name: lift
reward_terms.formula: Opposed lift above 15 mm for 0.10 s At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: reference_progress

reward_terms.name: wrist_reference
reward_terms.formula: Palm position and orientation potential toward the selected reference

reward_terms.name: active_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Pay for episode-best combined blade elevation and relative rotation while unsupported, opposed and actively moving the fingers.

reward_terms.name: passive_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Variation of relative orientation under opposed contact with nearly stationary fingers

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: Completes at least 50 degrees of wrist-relative turn while opposed with blades within 20 degrees of up At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in left-goal distance weighted by blade elevation under opposed contact Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: place_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in upright standing-height and blade-axis errors inside goal with hand contact Also guide the centre toward the target XY. Carry advances to descent at least 15 mm inside the zone. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: support_transfer
reward_terms.formula: First table support with hand contact following the turn and carried goal entry At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: After controlled support transfer, stable upright table support with hand contact released At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: durable_goal
reward_terms.formula: Maintains terminal goal for 0.5 s, penalty for subsequent disturbance Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Loses the opposed airborne plug before support Also penalize and reset the grasp attempt if the transport returns to support before entry or loses opposition for two steps.

reward_terms.name: time_and_control
reward_terms.formula: Living cost, small action term, hand/table cost, and safety penalty

reward_terms.name: leftward_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed decrease in distance to goal y during opposed unsupported turn and carry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: settling_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in object speed during supported hand contact following carried entry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance
reward_terms.formula: Increase in distance from the nearest pad after supported release. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: pip_target_gap
reward_terms.formula: For the five PIP joints, identify the filtered target's distance to the limit in the direction of the target error. Weight a quadratic ramp above 0.45 rad target-to-encoder gap, capped at 1.10 rad, by proximity within 0.25 rad of that limit. Charge the maximum joint cost per step.

reward_terms.name: substep_finger_limit_risk
reward_terms.formula: Take the maximum over all 20 joints and all 1 ms substeps of the 30 Hz interval. The per-joint risk is the larger of the 5–20 mrad overshoot ramp and the product of proximity within 35 mrad and toward-limit speed scaled from 5 to 17 rad/s. A first actual violation adds a terminal penalty of 4.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress
reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

body.text: The fixed criteria identify genuine turn and handover misses on episodes that appear upright by the end. Demo-shaped PPO, sensor-history pose memory and substep finger-risk shaping produced the selected actor. Lighter loading, explicit support-break costs, dense history, bounded palm lead and the direct CPU refinements did not produce stronger independent development evidence. The v4 final failed at one measured range excursion. The measured high-speed unload replay motivated a directional motor-effort envelope based on the published speed. Paired v4/v5 replays show similar success counts and smaller peak excursions. Final gate r0625 attains 61/64 full 60 s sequences with zero simulated violations and stops and reproduced results. The report-only reference environment has zero clean completions, with 57 placements followed by hardware violation classification. Physical torque-speed and contact calibration would narrow this remaining model dependence. The policy still lifts the plug higher than the demonstration and the arm can continue moving after release.

limitations: This verdict covers the single white deployment plug in simulation.
Grip torque, plug mass, and glove and table friction are estimated.
Contact dynamics and mechanical limit response are approximate. The contract replay checks the logged motion.
The active finger-motion predicate measures finger motion associated with wrist-relative turn.
The motor model uses published joint speeds and an assumed taper in available driving torque. Comparison to v4 and the harness reference environment is part of the simulation evidence.
Successful robot lifts rise 134.6 to 139.5 mm, compared with about 25 mm in the reconstructed white-plug demonstration.
The arm can continue moving after release. Representative development seed 8173546 has 1.273 m of palm travel from 10 to 60 s and no hand-object contact in that interval.
The separate report-only harness environment has zero clean completions in 64. Its final placement predicates hold in 57 episodes, all subsequently classified under hardware violations.

body.text: The operator opened target rounds and extended the run to 31.53 h of active time. Delivered s01 at 21.554 h from the original 2026-11-19T00:57:02Z run start, before the 24.53 h deadline. The package is the v5 task incumbent from dev gate r0609, verified in r0633. Use the first eight target trials to judge the demonstrated stages and replay the sent commands in v5 before model changes.

trials.evidence: The right-wrist view shows the plug entering the fingers near 1.3 s. Valid estimates show a 54 mm rise and blades within 13 degrees of up by 1.70 s, but the operator did not confirm a pickup and the grasp is occluded. The plug never has a valid carried entry. J4 reaches 28.12 Nm and the station halts at 2.84 s. The operator reports a side-lying plug outside the zone.

The right-wrist view shows brief contact near 1.30 s and the plug apart from the fingers later. Valid pose samples show a 55 mm transient rise, no upright sample, and no valid estimate after 1.73 s. At 18.47 s the video shows the plug below and away from the fingers. The operator reports a side-lying plug outside the zone at the end of 20 s. A continuous opposed turn and supported release are unconfirmed.

The wrist view briefly shows the plug against the thumb around 1.30 s and on the table with the grip open by 1.80 s. The visible rise reaches 15 mm with no blades-up sample. A later contact ends at 7.60 s with a J4 torque halt at 21.52 Nm. The last estimate is near its starting zone at y = -0.341 m and is about 89 degrees from blades up.

The right-wrist footage shows the plug near the thumb at 1.30 s, separated on its side at 1.80 s, and additional attempts later. The visible rise is at most 19 mm and there is no upright sample. The last valid estimate at 17.27 s is y = -0.360 m with 88.5 degrees of tilt. The operator reports side-lying placement outside the goal.

The right-wrist footage shows a tilted plug beside the closing fingers at 1.30 s and a separated plug on the table by 1.80 s. During a later contact the station halts at 4.20 s with J1 at 25.79 Nm. The largest logged finger excursion is 23.40 mrad. The last valid estimate is y = -0.349 m and the operator sees the plug on its side, still touching the hand.

The right-wrist view shows the plug airborne between fingers at 1.80 s and separated later. The visible rise is 100 mm. No valid pose has blades within 20 degrees of vertical. Across the final window the plug is on its side with its last estimate near (0.260, -0.106, -0.301) m, outside the goal and about 90 degrees from blades up. The largest logged finger excursion is 21.47 mrad.

The right-wrist footage shows the plug briefly raised near 1.30 s and back on the table by 1.80 s. During a repeat contact the station halts at 4.30 s with J1 at 25.93 Nm. The last valid estimate is y = -0.342 m and about 117 degrees from blades up. No continuous opposed turn and controlled release are established.

The right-wrist footage shows the closing fingers at the plug before motion stops. The greatest visible rise is 8.4 mm. A J1 torque halt at 22.82 Nm ends the trial at 1.06 s. The last valid plug estimate is y = -0.358 m with about 91 degrees of blade tilt.

body.next: Run all eight open-loop replays in the recorded v5 simulation. Compare the first grasp and the onset of torque in the target logs, and separate arm and finger tracking, object contact, and camera estimator visibility before choosing a change.

body.observation_mismatch: Track estimators only on valid target rows. Target visual validity spans 8.8 to 100 percent. For trial 1 the target loses its estimate after 1.73 s and has 8.8 percent valid, while the replay maintains 83 percent valid. The grasp and pose diverge, so this comparison cannot isolate sensor behavior from contact motion.
body.dynamics_mismatch: Before the first contact, mean palm position residual at 0.10 to 0.75 s is approximately 6.6 to 6.8 mm across trials and finger RMSE is 0.020 to 0.023 rad. After contact the first valid object residual reaches 20 mm between 1.10 and 1.43 s in seven trials. Trial 7 halts at 1.06 s. The station records five torque halts that the v5 replay does not reproduce on any of those trials. Trial 7 reaches 22.82 Nm on J1 versus the replay's 8.87 Nm maximum across joints. The replay instead halts on trial 5 at about 10.9 s, which runs the full duration on the target.
body.changes: Replay uses the frozen v5 physical model. It sets the full-precision first valid estimated object pose before the 1.5 s package ramp and drives the logged sent palm and finger commands into the station IK and finger chain. No actor is called. Quantify clock alignment and torque time courses before fitting joint-response and contact hypotheses.
body.start_pose_source: Original package start_pose.json and target state sample t=0

body.text: [redacted] r0635 judges 0/8 and records five torque halts. Frozen v5 replay r0636 matches the FK frame and finds the first valid 20 mm object divergence at 1.10 to 1.43 s in the seven trials that continue beyond first contact. A pre-contact grid shifts replay queries 20 ms earlier for the arm and 12.5 ms earlier for the fingers on every trial. Mean palm error drops to 4.64 to 4.76 mm and finger RMS to 0.014 to 0.017 rad. The target first exceeds 4 Nm at 0.96 s on all eight trials. Raw and sent actions match, and no jump or floor flags were recorded. First test response delay and loaded torque dynamics on sent-command replays, then vary contact stiffness, grip and friction. Preserve target commands only for replay and parameter fitting.

[redacted] contact identification used trials 0, 2 and 5 to fit and 1, 3, 4, 6 and 7 to check. The checked free wrist residual is 7.24 to 4.49 mm and finger residual 0.02130 to 0.01417 rad with 20 ms effective extra arm delay and 45 ms hand delay. With these timing changes, 1 mm glove margin, nominal hand friction 0.45 and a 6 ms hand and plug contact time constant, held-out age-aligned first-contact plug RMS is 16.22 versus 17.44 mm and signed 30 ms filtered torque RMS is 1.75 versus 2.13 Nm. A 3 mm margin gives 14.73 mm plug RMS with 1.91 Nm torque RMS. In the full sent-command replay the 1 mm fit yields 30.9 versus 36.1 mm mean valid object residual, still misses all five target stops and wrongly halts trial 5. Sampled instantaneous torque fits worse and does not identify the target torque peaks. Preserve the physical torque threshold and filter, adapt the nominal fit, and randomize delay, friction, compliance and glove margin across the supported alternatives. During PPO test an early contact-load cost as a separate comparison. Station response and contact are only partially identified.

simulator.name: MuJoCo
simulator.gpu_backend: MuJoCo Warp with float32 dynamics, the same nominal calibration, and randomized settings for PPO.
simulator.finger_motor_limit: Directional torque cap with full current-limited effort through 90% of public joint speed and a linear taper to zero at the published speed.

scene.model: Full provided Marvin Wuji MJCF, both arms/hands and original collision geometry, with a single plug, table, floor, and column.

plug.state_frame: Housing centre, +Z toward blade tips, +Y across the blade gap. Identity object/body frame.
plug.geometry: Station housing and two blade OBJ parts from given/recon. Exact specified dimensions and axes.
plug.physical_prior: The comparable charger teardown weighs 58.5 g. The video supports the housing geometry and grasp scale, with no force data. Used the operator 60 g estimate and housing-plus-blades bounding-box inertia. Contact pair assumptions are 0.40 sliding at the table, 0.80 hand material friction. The PC-glass study is a material prior and its interface differs from the station. The video shows little post-release slide but does not identify either coefficient.
plug.contact: Housing and separate blade colliders, elliptic sliding and torsional contact, solimp [0.93,0.98,0.001]. Hand and plug solref time constants and explicit table-to-plug solref are 6 ms, at critical damping. Static friction, table geometry and masses are preserved at the previous nominal values. Glove friction is 0.45.

reference.method: White cycle with d2s_reference progress, object start and goal alignment and SLERP. Palm axis mapping is derived from reconstructed MANO joints. Applying a world-up yaw adjustment of 150 degrees to the wrist and its offset selects a more reachable approach heading while keeping plug start and goal constraints. The palm height is projected above -0.225 m in the retarget. These embodiment adjustments guide rewards and are not executed trajectories.

body.arm: Published 100 Hz palm clamp and jump stop, measured-seed DLS IK with the 5 degree ranges, delayed 100 Hz joint reference and velocity, and the provided arm capsules. The position actuator receives q_ref + (D/K) q_ref_dot so velocity tracking effort is counted inside each motor's effort cap. Compensate modeled bias minus gravity compensation separately. Use only contact EFC rows for the right arm or hand against table, plug, column or parked arm to estimate external torque with J transpose f. The existing 30 ms estimated torque filter and 20 Nm halt operate on that signal. Add 20 ms to the joint reference delays as a lumped effective fit to command log and encoder timing. Published physical bounds are preserved.
body.hand: Public geometry and deployed limits including the 1 mm glove collision margin. Finger targets have 45 ms delay and 2 Hz low pass. Internal position gains are 12x vendor kp and 3x vendor kv as a response approximation with current-limited torque. Nominal evaluation uses 0.6x joint effort, with 0.1 deg encoder noise. The deployed finger ranges remain fixed. A 2 ms unilateral joint-limit time constant at 1 ms physics integration reduces numerical penetration through the range. The 100 Hz sampling, 2 Hz filter and existing proprioceptive observation delay are preserved. The driving torque caps use each joint speed from RIGHT_HAND.md section 2 at every 1 ms substep. The opposite-direction cap retains the nominal braking torque. Contact can backdrive the joint past the published speed because the model does not clip joint velocity or angle.
body.sensor: Default d2s_sensor.PoseSensor fed at 60 Hz. 48 surface samples from the complete object mesh, visual points clipped by calibrated ego-camera geometry. Arm caps and fitted capsules for hand-link mesh occluders. Proprioception delayed by a lognormal draw quantized to the nearest 60 Hz row.

initial_conditions.object: Uniform independent x/y offsets ±10 mm and blade yaw ±10 degrees about -90 degrees, X-up on the supported face.
initial_conditions.start_check: Hold controller uses the reset palm so the entire hold check, including any ramp rows, can test a stationary hand. Candidate evaluation simulates the actual package start ramp.

cpu_gpu_outcome_parity.criterion: Outcome parity (same policy, both backends, >= min-seeds seeds, scored by the evaluator's judge) is the criterion that counts. State-level and replay checks are diagnostics.
cpu_gpu_outcome_parity.policy: The same r0445 weight export that was delivered in s01. Independent of its own training and the replay tuning.
cpu_gpu_outcome_parity.other_detail: The 128 paired fixed-action audit has 119/128 versus 128/128 lifts, zero turns, drops, hardware violations and stops on both backends. It passes and is weaker evidence than the closed-loop check. The short audit evaluates actual final posture and half-second rest without requiring 60 seconds; task-suite scoring keeps the full-duration predicate.

body.limitations: The replay identifies effective timing and part of the first-contact discrepancy. The physical drive and acquisition phase are confounded, arm joint RMS grows for some fitted cases, and the model still misses the measured reaction torque peaks and contact transitions. Closed-loop paired rates agree more closely than the per-seed outcomes. Kinematic reference overlap reaches 3.75 mm. The model uses one white plug and nominally fixed table geometry as specified.

revision.cause: [redacted] target r0635 has five torque halts and zero complete placements. r0636 misses the halts and shows the first grasp is the first material residual. gpu_backend.physics: Same 1 ms plant, effort envelopes, model and actuator targets under Warp. Controller delay buffers hold the longest randomized delay. Delay, contact softness, friction and margin can vary between training worlds.
gpu_backend.validation: On 128 paired 13 s closed-loop starts, CPU 56/128 and Warp 55/128 complete the short audit with no measured hardware violations or stops. CPU has one dropped interval, Warp zero. The outcome parity checker passes.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: Completes at least 50 degrees of wrist-relative turn while opposed with blades within 20 degrees of up At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress

Carry advances to descent at least 15 mm inside the zone. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: support_transfer
reward_terms.formula: First table support with hand contact following the turn and carried goal entry At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: After controlled support transfer, stable upright table support with hand contact released At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: durable_goal
reward_terms.formula: Maintains terminal goal for 0.5 s, penalty for subsequent disturbance Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Loses the opposed airborne plug before support Also penalize and reset the grasp attempt if the transport returns to support before entry or loses opposition for two steps.

reward_terms.name: time_and_control
reward_terms.formula: Living cost, small action term, hand/table cost, and safety penalty

reward_terms.name: leftward_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed decrease in distance to goal y during opposed unsupported turn and carry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: settling_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in object speed during supported hand contact following carried entry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance
reward_terms.formula: Increase in distance from the nearest pad after supported release. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: substep_finger_limit_risk
reward_terms.formula: Take the maximum over all 20 joints and all 1 ms substeps of the 30 Hz interval. The per-joint risk is the larger of the 5–20 mrad overshoot ramp and the product of proximity within 35 mrad and toward-limit speed scaled from 5 to 17 rad/s. A first actual violation adds a terminal penalty of 4.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress
reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

body.reflection: Archived v4 PPO export from r0445 and target round s01, replayed in v6 with no weight changes. All 64 clean physical starts lift, 49 turn, and 32 complete the physical sequence. One late palm tracking record falls outside the state-consistency check. The 31 clean complete rollouts and the calibrated first-contact gap establish the comparison for target-informed PPO.

body.text: In the eight nominal v6 sent-command replays, every first-contact filtered torque peak occurs with the hand on both the tabletop and plug. Nominal peaks are 9.39 to 10.97 Nm and remain below the measured target peaks. Penalize both the early simulated reaction moment and table contact before a sustained opposed lift, so the network must learn to pick without bracing against the table. Compare a matched PPO continuation, this acquisition reward alone, acquisition reward plus bounded measured-palm target lead, and acquisition reward plus a preference for lower carry. All start from the archived r0445 PPO lineage and use the v6 Warp uncertainty ranges. Local dry rewards and the v6 feasibility evidence precede training.

body.hypothesis: The previously trained PPO actor still demonstrates full ordered manipulation on enough starts in calibrated v6 to establish feasibility, although its measured grasp performance fell in the revised contact model.

body.text: v6 feasibility gate r0644 passes on 13/32 fresh starts, with all 32 lifts, 23 turns and zero measured violations or stops. I reviewed both failures and both successes. In seeds 881798842 and 1567381196 the plug is near the fingers at 2.30 s and upright by 10 s, while the measured continuous carry and opening stage fails despite 56.42 and 56.53 seconds of rest. The successes preserve the ordered release and rest for at least 56.37 seconds. In the calibrated open-loop replays, direct tabletop contact accounts for 56 to 89 percent of the same-joint filtered peak moment. Start the four r0643 PPO comparisons now, each with 12M added active steps and 2M export spacing. The bounded branch tests 65 mm position and 0.30 rad orientation target lead. The carry branch adds the existing rise cost above 75 mm. Both are separate from the matched early-contact comparison.

reward_terms.name: settling_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in object speed during supported hand contact following carried entry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance
reward_terms.formula: Increase in distance from the nearest pad after supported release. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: acquisition_contact_load
reward_terms.formula: Before the first sustained opposed lift, subtract 0.45 times the squared external arm moment ramp from 5 to 13 Nm. Subtract 0.12 for hand-to-table contact over the same period.

reward_terms.name: substep_finger_limit_risk
reward_terms.formula: Take the maximum over all 20 joints and all 1 ms substeps of the 30 Hz interval. The per-joint risk is the larger of the 5–20 mrad overshoot ramp and the product of proximity within 35 mrad and toward-limit speed scaled from 5 to 17 rad/s. A first actual violation adds a terminal penalty of 4.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress

The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

[redacted] additionally loses early grasps and halts on table-like reactions. In the calibrated diagnostics the candidate reduces median pre-lift arm torque from 11.74 to 8.96 Nm and table contact from 227 to 115.5 ms.

reward_terms.name: opposition

reward_terms.name: lift_progress

reward_terms.name: reference_progress

reward_terms.name: wrist_reference

reward_terms.name: active_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Pay for episode-best combined blade elevation and relative rotation while unsupported, opposed and actively moving the fingers.

reward_terms.name: passive_rotation
reward_terms.formula: Variation of relative orientation under opposed contact with nearly stationary fingers

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: Completes at least 50 degrees of wrist-relative turn while opposed with blades within 20 degrees of up At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in left-goal distance weighted by blade elevation under opposed contact Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: place_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in upright standing-height and blade-axis errors inside goal with hand contact Also guide the centre toward the target XY. Carry advances to descent at least 15 mm inside the zone. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: support_transfer
reward_terms.formula: First table support with hand contact following the turn and carried goal entry At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: After controlled support transfer, stable upright table support with hand contact released At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: durable_goal
reward_terms.formula: Maintains terminal goal for 0.5 s, penalty for subsequent disturbance Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Loses the opposed airborne plug before support Also penalize and reset the grasp attempt if the transport returns to support before entry or loses opposition for two steps.

reward_terms.name: time_and_control
reward_terms.formula: Living cost, small action term, hand/table cost, and safety penalty

reward_terms.name: leftward_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed decrease in distance to goal y during opposed unsupported turn and carry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: settling_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in object speed during supported hand contact following carried entry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance
reward_terms.formula: Increase in distance from the nearest pad after supported release. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: acquisition_contact_load
reward_terms.formula: Before the first sustained opposed lift, subtract 0.45 times the squared external arm moment ramp from 5 to 13 Nm. Subtract 0.12 for hand-to-table contact over the same period.

reward_terms.name: substep_finger_limit_risk
reward_terms.formula: Take the maximum over all 20 joints and all 1 ms substeps of the 30 Hz interval. The per-joint risk is the larger of the 5–20 mrad overshoot ramp and the product of proximity within 35 mrad and toward-limit speed scaled from 5 to 17 rad/s. A first actual violation adds a terminal penalty of 4.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress
reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: turn
reward_terms.formula: Completes at least 50 degrees of wrist-relative turn while opposed with blades within 20 degrees of up At most once per episode across retries.

reward_terms.name: carry_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in left-goal distance weighted by blade elevation under opposed contact Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: place_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in upright standing-height and blade-axis errors inside goal with hand contact Also guide the centre toward the target XY. Carry advances to descent at least 15 mm inside the zone. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: support_transfer
reward_terms.formula: First table support with hand contact following the turn and carried goal entry At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: release
reward_terms.formula: After controlled support transfer, stable upright table support with hand contact released At most once per episode across retries. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: durable_goal
reward_terms.formula: Maintains terminal goal for 0.5 s, penalty for subsequent disturbance Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: drop
reward_terms.formula: Loses the opposed airborne plug before support Also penalize and reset the grasp attempt if the transport returns to support before entry or loses opposition for two steps.

reward_terms.name: time_and_control
reward_terms.formula: Living cost, small action term, hand/table cost, and safety penalty

reward_terms.name: leftward_progress
reward_terms.formula: Signed decrease in distance to goal y during opposed unsupported turn and carry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: settling_progress
reward_terms.formula: Decrease in object speed during supported hand contact following carried entry. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance
reward_terms.formula: Increase in distance from the nearest pad after supported release. Credit positive physical progress only beyond the prior episode best. The same excursion earns once across retries.

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: acquisition_contact_load
reward_terms.formula: Before the first sustained opposed lift, subtract 0.45 times the squared external arm moment ramp from 5 to 13 Nm. Subtract 0.12 for hand-to-table contact over the same period.

reward_terms.name: substep_finger_limit_risk
reward_terms.formula: Take the maximum over all 20 joints and all 1 ms substeps of the 30 Hz interval. The per-joint risk is the larger of the 5–20 mrad overshoot ramp and the product of proximity within 35 mrad and toward-limit speed scaled from 5 to 17 rad/s. A first actual violation adds a terminal penalty of 4.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress
reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

body.reflection: Matched r0445 PPO continuation in calibrated v6 with the new timing and contact distributions. Control for the acquisition reward.

trials.evidence: The right-wrist view shows a pickup near 1.7 s, a turn through the fingers by 2.4 s, and blades-up placement with the fingers withdrawing near 3.6–4.5 s. The plug stays upright and clear in the later video. The final 16 valid estimates are near (0.3517, -0.0047, -0.2926) m, with median tilt 0.43 degrees and maximum displacement from the window median below 0.24 mm. The operator confirms upright placement. There is no station stop. The thumb PIP encoder reaches 1.42258 rad at 3.033 s against a deployed upper limit of 1.40 rad. The 22.58 mrad excursion exceeds the 20 mrad hardware allowance, so the trial does not satisfy criteria v1.

The right-wrist view shows the thumb and fingers near the plug at 1.40 s and separated from a side-lying plug at 1.70 and 2.00 s. The greatest valid rise is 16 mm. The hand revisits it around 3.60 s, then a 22.36 Nm J4 torque halt ends the trial at 4.10 s. The final estimate is outside the goal at y = -0.330 m.

The right-wrist view shows initial contact and the plug separated under the hand by 1.70 s, then repeated approaches to a plug on its side. The valid pose rises briefly by 41 mm with no visible upright pose. The estimator is valid for 11.8 percent of the trial. There is no final valid estimate after 4.57 s. The later wrist view and operator report both place the plug on its side outside the goal.

The right-wrist view shows the plug already separated beneath the fingers around 1.70 s and still unattached around 2.00 s. The greatest valid rise is 55 mm, but the footage does not establish sustained opposed contact through an active turn. The last valid estimate is y = -0.242 m with 80.1 degrees of tilt. The final wrist view shows the plug on its side outside the goal.

The right-wrist view shows the hand raising the plug around 1.70 s and the plug separated from the grip by about 2.00–2.40 s. The greatest observed rise is 109 mm. The terminal estimate is at (0.4044, -0.1123, -0.3003) m with about 90.5 degrees of tilt. The video and operator report confirm a side-lying plug outside the goal and no controlled release.

The right-wrist view shows the plug beneath the fingers around 1.70 s, with no opposed hold by 2.00 s. The valid estimate briefly rises 78 mm without confirming a continuous blades-up turn. The plug is visibly separated and turning below the hand around 3.60 s. It ends on its side at y = -0.140 m, outside the goal.

Both wrist views show the fingers beside the plug through 1.07 s. The greatest valid rise is 9.6 mm. J1 reaches 26.82 Nm and the station stops at 1.10 s, before any sustained opposed lift or turn. The last valid plug estimate is on its side at y = -0.354 m.

The right-wrist view shows a pickup and changing blade orientation through 1.70–2.00 s. The valid rise reaches 125 mm. The plug is out of the grip at 2.40 s and later lies on its side. Its final y = -0.098 m is in the goal zone, but the last valid blade tilt is 90.0 degrees and there is no supported upright opening.

body.next: Replay all eight sent command streams in frozen simulation v6. Compare initial tabletop torque, loss of opposition, and thumb PIP response around the physical placement in trial 0 before selecting training or model changes.

reward_terms.name: settling_progress

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance

reward_terms.name: recontact
reward_terms.formula: Hand recontacts the supported upright plug following the first opening.

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal
reward_terms.formula: At the training horizon, the released plug still meets the resting goal over the last 0.5 s. Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. Check this sequence at every 60 Hz sample.

reward_terms.name: acquisition_contact_load
reward_terms.formula: Before the first sustained opposed lift, subtract 0.45 times the squared external arm moment ramp from 5 to 13 Nm. Subtract 0.12 for hand-to-table contact over the same period.

reward_terms.name: substep_finger_limit_risk
reward_terms.formula: Take the maximum over all 20 joints and all 1 ms substeps of the 30 Hz interval. The per-joint risk is the larger of the 5–20 mrad overshoot ramp and the product of proximity within 35 mrad and toward-limit speed scaled from 5 to 17 rad/s. A first actual violation adds a terminal penalty of 4.

reward_terms.name: load_transfer_progress
reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. The potential multiplies upright alignment by 0.35 standing-height progress, 0.25 low object velocity and spin, and 0.40 vertical table load saturated at 0.85 plug weights.

reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.

body.reflection: Add the early arm reaction and hand-table contact cost to the matched v6 PPO continuation. Target [redacted] and the calibrated replays identify loaded tabletop contact around acquisition.

body.observation_mismatch: Use only valid target estimator rows for object residuals. In trials 2 and 3 the target estimator is valid on 11.8 and 23.3 percent of rows, compared with 85.7 and 91.5 percent predicted in replay. The target videos show failed opposed grips and the simulated object moves along another path. The resulting visibility gap cannot identify an independent sensor-model error.
body.dynamics_mismatch: Mean precontact palm error between 0.10 and 0.80 s is 4.66–4.91 mm. In seven trials the first valid object position residual exceeds 20 mm between 1.23 and 1.70 s. Both observed torque halts are absent in replay. Target peaks are 22.36 and 26.82 Nm in trials 1 and 6 against simulated peaks 9.61 and 8.83. Replays 0, 2, 4 and 7 end upright after a controlled simulated release, while only target trial 0 stands. Trial 0 measures a 22.58 mrad thumb PIP excursion at 3.033 s. Its nominal replay has a peak sampled joint excursion of 1.03 mrad. Simulated opposition holds and the hardware limit resolves much more rigidly.
body.changes: Replay applies the exact logged sent palm and finger targets to the recorded v6 IK, actuator and physical contact model. Start from the package ramp and exact first valid full-precision estimated object pose. No actor is called. Diagnose grip retention during the turn, and vary thumb PIP clearance and contact load within the same hardware bounds after this replay.
body.start_pose_source: Submitted package start_pose.json and first valid target state row at t=0
