body.text: [redacted] judgment r0811 and replay r0814 show a first-lift or early grasp divergence in seven paths. Increase opposed grasp quality during training only using the existing 1.4 N acquisition qualification and capped 2.5 N smooth force shaping. The dry traces return +63.12 with eight completions out of twelve, versus −0.79 for hold and −0.95 for random, with no faults or stops. Continue PPO from r0787, retain the 60 Hz strict turn reward and the recorded v7 simulator, and test whether opposition is retained across low-friction starts without raising acquisition load or measured joint excursions. The lowest-friction results, independent full-duration starts and paired gate will determine whether to keep it.

V7 strict-turn PPO loses full-duration contract compliance after early checkpoints in r0794, r0802 and the r0815–r0823 follow-ups, often after a nominal placement. Run a matched 6M-step continuation from r0787 at learning rate 0.00001 instead of 0.000035. Earlier continuing updates have KL around 0.004–0.008, so check that the lower rate still moves the policy while retaining reliable phase transitions and quiet late behavior. Rewards, resets, deployment action map and frozen v7 evaluator remain the same.

The [redacted] sent-command finger fits find no usable calibrated change. For trial 3's measured +24.33 mrad pinky PIP event, nominal reaches +0.56 mrad in the same window. Softening only that limit to 12 ms reaches +5.34 mrad and worsens visible object error from 80.87 to 115.33 mm. For trial 5's +23.02 mrad middle MCP2 event, nominal stays 95.88 mrad inside the limit. The most favorable of the examined glove and gain changes stays 65.85 mrad inside. Removing adjacent finger exclusions in our diagnostic copy misses both excursions, and exposing all but MCP1 pair contacts worsens free-motion finger RMS from 11.79 to 66.54 mrad. Keep the public adjacent-contact exclusions. A 4 mm tabletop contact margin improves the visible object path of trial 3 but worsens trial 5 middle MCP2 RMSE. Test it on the withheld trials in rounds 4 and 5 before relying on it. The frozen v7 simulator remains the evaluation model.

body.text: All eight [redacted] state logs reconstruct the exact r0795 actions to below 1e-5 in mm, degrees and mrad using recorded observations and previous requested targets. A one-step proprioceptive offset immediately worsens agreement. Off-policy substitution on the same command history isolates the large action differences after first contact. From 1.10 to 1.40 s, substituting only capture-aligned simulated object poses changes mean requested wrist position by 1.33 mm and hand targets by 5.21 mrad per-joint RMS, against 0.33 mm and 1.74 mrad for simulated proprioception alone. From 1.40 to 2.50 s the respective changes are 5.57 mm and 28.81 mrad versus 1.14 mm and 6.38 mrad. This diagnostic holds target pose-validity and previous actions fixed, so it supports modeling early object/contact dynamics and does not identify a sensor or controller fault. Tested tabletop friction above the v7 value worsens aggregate torque RMS in both fit groups. The 25–55 mrad pinky margin also fails the compliant-pinky stress, with 23/24 joint excursions in each setting versus zero without the margin at the same compliance. Retain the exact action bounds and nominal simulation.

body.text: Independent lowering of effective glove–plug friction to 0.18 with plug support coefficient 0.52 improves early object RMS in [redacted] held-out trials from 36.81 to 25.69 mm and torque RMS from 1.887 to 1.483 Nm. On [redacted] the same model worsens early object RMS from 10.68 to 30.65 mm and torque RMS from 1.457 to 1.637 Nm. At 0.34 glove–plug and 0.40 support, [redacted] improves to 27.69 mm and 1.594 Nm, while [redacted] is 11.31 mm and 1.426 Nm. Keep frozen v7 and test a low-friction uncertainty mixture, 35 percent of randomized subsets in .24–.40, keeping plug–table friction independent and the 25 percent nominal subset. The 256-world smoke finds 70 low-friction worlds, 69 exact nominal and 65 low-friction worlds with higher support than grasp friction. Continue the exact r0787 actor for 6M steps. Predict better retention under weak friction without degrading nominal verified turn or measured excursions.

body.text: The public arm spec gives a flange payload of 0.866 kg. The copied v7 model contains 0.526613 kg of right-hand bodies and zero modeled mass at the wrist connector and camera bodies. In diagnostic copies place the 0.339387 kg difference at the fixed connector or 25 mm toward the palm, with a 0.00034 kg m² inertia prior. Position, joints, grip limits and collisions are unchanged. Test the expected inertial effect on free response and the full sent-command contact phases of rounds 4 and 5 before considering a simulation revision.

The r0835, r0842 and r0850 learning-rate continuation loses late contract compliance even with a smaller PPO update rate. The earlier r0493 export-averaging comparison produced 63/64 on its development cohort, although that does not establish transfer. Test v7 PPO with a 0.95 running average of only the single actor's parameters at export, retaining the live exploration policy, reward, reset distribution, architecture and action map. Allow 9M new simulation steps from r0787 with evaluations every 1.5M. Predict fewer late excursions and stable turns across exports.

body.reflection: Matched v7 strict-turn PPO with a 20 percent share of randomized worlds at combined upper grip effort and 8 ms finger limit time. The actor and the nominal evaluator stay fixed.

body.text: The missing flange payload test does not improve sent-command replay. Completing 0.866 kg with the two connector mass centres raises mean free palm error from 3.835 to 4.081–4.110 mm in [redacted] and from 3.917 to 4.174–4.203 mm in [redacted]. Both choices worsen early signed torque RMS and leave object RMS effectively unchanged in [redacted]. Keep v7's effective calibrated plant and record the unmodeled payload mass as a limitation. An independent 24-start contact-stress audit shows r0832 improves the 0.34 grasp-friction profile to 23/24 controlled transfers versus r0787's 14/24, with a pre-lift median of 7.11 versus 8.36 Nm. Every tested actor fails to turn at 0.26. At high effort plus compliant limits r0832 has 20/24 hardware excursions versus six for r0787, so this is a robustness trade-off. The exact r0832 action bounds remove orientation errors in its offline 60 s audit, but four late positions still diverge while targets saturate at the inner y = −0.49 m boundary. Keep testing the trained variant.

reward_terms.name: time_and_control
reward_terms.formula: Living cost, small action term, hand/table cost, and safety penalty

reward_terms.name: leftward_progress

reward_terms.name: settling_progress

reward_terms.name: hand_clearance

reward_terms.name: recontact

reward_terms.name: terminal_goal

Require upright carried entry in the turned grip, continuous hand contact until the table takes the load, and continuous upright table support until opening. reward_terms.formula: Pay episode-best progress in an upright handover inside the zone and within 65 mm of standing height while touching the plug. reward_terms.name: quiet_loaded_support
reward_terms.formula: One bonus after two consecutive 30 Hz samples with continuous table support, hand contact, tilt <= 15 degrees, speed < 0.06 m/s, spin < 1.5 rad/s, and vertical load >= 0.55 plug weights.
